scenes.narration: Legroom shows the free space on your Mac, right in the menu bar.
Set a line, and it warns you before the disk fills.
Each rule previews what it would remove. You approve it, and items can go to the Trash.
Recommended lists caches Legroom knows, like npm and Playwright.
What Grew shows which folders grew since last time.
Space Map shows where the space went. Find Files lists large, old and duplicate files.
Nine dollars, once, with a seven day free trial.

bumper.note: Purplelink LLC brand bumper at start and end; narration never overlaps the bumpers.
